summary: DeepSeek V3 JAX is a lightweight reimplementation of the DeepSeek V3 model in pure JAX for research experiments. It offers a Python API and runs locally without needing an API key, but installation requires manual JAX setup and no PyPI package exists. Researchers wanting a compact, open‑source reference implementation will find it useful, though the project is brand new with limited community traction. Its main strength is the concise 200‑line JAX code, while the lack of tests and minimal benchmark data are notable drawbacks.
